source.quote: The revised structure is settled. Each entry will remain one readable unit rather than a cramped four-column table: the original **Sahidic Coptic**, its Romanized reading guide, the **extant Greek papyrus text and Greek transliteration where preserved**, the Syriac-Aramaic retroversion and its reading guide, then English. Missing Greek will be stated plainly instead of silently reconstructed.
